maria (Security): @auditor_jones yep we can do that. Quick clarifying q: which customer/org scope are you asking about (org-wide or a specific AWS account / project)? and do you need raw logs or a packaged redacted bundle? :paperclip:

auditor_jones: org-wide is fine but prioritize the infra account where rollout happened. Prefer a tamper-evident bundle (signed manifest) + a short video showing the playback and the Splunk/KQL query that produced the evidence.

kevin (Infra): I can export the RBAC change trail from our auth-service index and the API access traces from apigw-logs. Plan: 1) snapshot role-change events, 2) capture corresponding API keys/usage (hashed), 3) include the KMS audit events from cloudtrail/kms-audit index. Will produce an S3 presigned bundle.

maria (Security): For KMS proof: we'll include the KMS key metadata (ARN/ID), rotation record, and the CMK creation event. We can also include the HSM certificate chain export from the KMS provider if allowed by policy. Note: that certificate blob might be sensitive — will coordinate redaction with legal.

auditor_jones: ok, redaction OK but must preserve the key ID and rotation timestamps and a signed manifest showing file checksums. Also we need to see correlation between the RBAC grant and the API calls (request IDs).

kevin (Infra): sample Splunk queries I plan to run: ```
index=auth-service "role.grant" OR "role.update" earliest=-30d@d | table _time, user, service_account, role, request_id
index=apigw-logs request_id=* | search service_account=<svc-id> earliest=-30d@d | table _time, request_id, path, status, response_time
index=kms-audit eventName="GenerateDataKey*" OR eventName="CreateKey" earliest=-30d@d | table _time, userIdentity.arn, kmsKeyId, eventName, requestParameters
```

maria (Security): For the playback demo I'll use our internal "evidence-playback" tool — it loads event streams for a given request_id and replays timeline with contexts (RBAC, NTP-corrected timestamps). Example CLI to generate a signed bundle: ```
./evidence-playback bundle --request-ids 1234abcd,5678efgh --output /tmp/bundle.tar.gz --sign-with /opt/keys/compliance-signing.key
sha256sum /tmp/bundle.tar.gz > /tmp/bundle.tar.gz.sha256
```

maria (Security): I'll prepare a short script that shows how we correlate RBAC event -> KMS decrypt/generate call -> api request. Example correlation snippet (pseudocode): ```
# find role grant -> service account
role_event = query_auth(index, "role.grant", svc_account)
# find KMS usage around event time
kms_events = query_kms(index, role_event.time +- 5m)
# find api calls referencing service account
api_calls = query_apigw(index, svc_account, role_event.time +- 30m)
replay_timeline(role_event, kms_events, api_calls)
```
